newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lai Sun Garment year net rises slightly.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun Garment year net rises slightly.

text.p: Company name Lai Sun Garment (International) Ltd
NOTE - Lai Sun Garment manufactures and exports garments. It also has interests in property rental and sales, share investment and restaurant operation.
The exceptional item represents expenses incurred in connection with the issue of US$120 million guaranteed bonds by a subsidiary during the year.

Comparative figures have been reclassified to conform with current year presentation. In addition, the gain on disposal of land and buildings in Crocodile Garments Ltd Group, a sub-group of the group, in prior year has been restated to conform with the provision of Statements of Standard Accounting Practice No. 17, which do not allow revaluation reserves realised on disposal of certain fixed assets to form part of the gain or loss on disposal.

In restating the financial statements of 1995 due to this change in accounting treatment, the net profit for that year was reduced by HK$4.93 million. As the amount was directly transferred to retained profits, there was no effect on the retained profits at August 1, 1995.
Total dividend for year is 55 H.K. cents (including interim dividend of 30 cents) vs 65 cents.
